LEAVE AND LICENSE AGREEMENT

This Leave and License Agreement ("Agreement") is made at Pune on this 1st day of April, 2026,

BETWEEN

Mrs. Anjali Deshmukh, residing at Flat No. 402, Sunrise Apartments, Baner Road, Pune, Maharashtra
400045, hereinafter referred to as the "Licensor",

AND

Mr. Rahul Verma, residing at present at Flat No. 402, Sunrise Apartments, Baner Road, Pune,
Maharashtra 400045, hereinafter referred to as the "Licensee".

The Licensor and the Licensee shall together be referred to as the "Parties".

WHEREAS the Licensor is the absolute owner of the residential flat bearing No. 402, admeasuring
650 sq. ft. carpet area, situated at Sunrise Apartments, Baner Road, Pune ("the Licensed Premises"),
and has agreed to grant leave and license of the Licensed Premises to the Licensee on a
leave and license basis, and the Licensee has agreed to take the same, on the terms recorded below.

NOW THIS AGREEMENT WITNESSES AS FOLLOWS:

1. TERM

1.1 This leave and license agreement shall be for a period of eleven (11) months commencing from
1st April 2026 and ending on 28th February 2027, unless renewed or terminated earlier in accordance
with this Agreement.

1.2 This Agreement does not create any tenancy rights in favour of the Licensee and is executed
strictly as a leave and license arrangement under Section 24 of the Maharashtra Rent Control Act,
1999.

2. LICENSE FEE AND DEPOSIT

2.1 The Licensee shall pay to the Licensor a monthly license fee (monthly rent) of Rs. 32,000/-
(Rupees Thirty Two Thousand only), payable in advance on or before the 5th day of every calendar
month.

2.2 The Licensee shall pay to the Licensor a refundable interest-free security deposit of Rs.
1,60,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Sixty Thousand only) prior to taking possession of the Licensed
Premises. The security deposit shall be refunded within 15 days of vacating the premises, subject to
deduction of any dues or damages.

2.3 There shall be a lock-in period of three (3) months from the commencement date, during which
neither Party may terminate this Agreement.

3. MAINTENANCE AND UTILITIES

3.1 The Licensee shall bear and pay the electricity, water, and society maintenance charges levied
on the Licensed Premises during the subsistence of this Agreement.

3.2 The Licensor shall be responsible for structural repairs to the Licensed Premises.

4. TERMINATION

4.1 Either Party may terminate this Agreement by giving one (1) month's prior written notice to the
other Party, after expiry of the lock-in period.

4.2 Upon termination or expiry, the Licensee shall hand over vacant, peaceful possession of the
Licensed Premises to the Licensor in the same condition as received, normal wear and tear excepted.

5. GOVERNING LAW

5.1 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India and the courts at Pune shall have
exclusive jurisdiction.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the Parties have executed this Agreement on the day, month, and year first
above written.

LICENSOR: ______________________          LICENSEE: ______________________
